name: Skillet "Chicken Pot Pie" with Zucchini, Carrot, Celery & Pastry Topping

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a 9-inch ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, working in batches, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally and scraping up any browned bits, until veggies are soft, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in the reserved bowl.
Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini and set aside.
When the veggies are done, add flour to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until veggies are well coated, about 1 minute.

Add zucchini, shredded chicken, broth, and cream to the skillet, stir to combine, then bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove pot pie filling from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup chicken or vegetable broth
½ cup heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place egg in a small bowl and whisk.

When the filling is done, carefully lay pie crust over the filling, crimping the edges as desired. (Depending how deep your skillet is, either overlap the pie crust over the skillet edge or fit the pastry fully inside the skillet.) Cut a few slits in the center of the pastry to allow steam to vent, then brush with egg wash.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until pastry is golden, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide pot pie between plates and enjoy!
